description: Check the requested private render and its output URL, errors and recovery guidance. Keep workspaceId from creation. When a video is available, call review_video_project to show playback. A queued or rendering state is not completion. Do not automatically submit another render on failure.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace override. For a new plan, omit this field so the server resolves the account default. A workspace ID returned by an account read is not a user selection. Supply this field only for a user-selected workspace or the workspace of an existing saved project. Ask only when the server requires selection; never fall back after denied access.

name: get_video_render_status
title: Check video render
